lines.text: Moses says the LORD came from Sinai, dawned from Seir, and shone forth from Mount Paran.
Moses asks the LORD to give the Urim and Thummim to Levi, whom He tested at Massah and Meribah.
Moses calls Benjamin the beloved of the LORD and says he rests upon God's shoulders.
Moses compares Joseph's majesty to a firstborn bull and names the myriads of Ephraim and the thousands of Reuben.
Moses says Dan is a lion's cub leaping out of Gilead, and he wants Asher to be the most blessed of sons.
